capabilities.capability: Drawings are stored as strokes: ordered point lists placed in a 3D scene, captured from mouse or tablet.
capabilities.pro_use: Studios mix hand-drawn 2D characters, storyboards and motion graphics into 3D sets in one file.

match.note: Puppet strokes are SVG path data on a 2D artboard; there is no 3D placement of strokes (2D layers in 3D space belong to WP-36/WP-42).

capabilities.capability: Each point carries its own thickness, opacity, weight and texture rotation, so a line can vary along its length.
capabilities.pro_use: Animators get tapered, pressure-shaped ink without extra geometry and can edit width point by point later.

match.note: Rig Canvas ink bakes pressure into an outline shape (perfect-freehand) and puppet strokes carry one width/opacity per stroke; per-point attributes and line styles are WP-15.

capabilities.capability: A stroke can be drawn as an outline line, a filled area, or both, from one material.
capabilities.pro_use: Line-and-fill character art: ink lines over flat colour, coloured independently.

match.note: Every stroke has a fill slot and an ink slot; the grease-pencil renderer splits such strokes into fill-only and line-only GP strokes.

capabilities.capability: Per-stroke curve types (polyline, Bezier, Catmull-Rom, NURBS) with resolution, closing and cap shape settings.
capabilities.pro_use: Clean-up artists switch rough polylines to smooth curves and tune caps for a consistent ink look.

match.note: SVG paths already hold Bezier curves and closed shapes (read by puppet.import); caps are always round and there is no curve-type conversion or curve editing tool (WP-18).

capabilities.capability: A ready-made 2D animation starting file: white background, plain colour view, front drawing plane, line and fill layers, auto-keying on.
capabilities.pro_use: Teams start every shot from the same template so settings never drift between artists.

match.note: film.create makes a film folder with empty sources; film.from_template builds a storyboard from a format template.

capabilities.capability: Add an empty drawing object, or one holding a single reference stroke, to start drawing at once.
capabilities.pro_use: Quick set-up of a new character or prop container before drawing.

match.note: A new puppet starts from a template (humanoid, doodle) that defines its parts; cast.generate can also build a full original character.

capabilities.capability: A built-in 2D test head with preset materials and layers.
capabilities.pro_use: Used as a standard test object for checking materials, modifiers and effects.

match.note: Doodleberry's equivalent is its benchmark films and golden frames (python -m dbe test) plus the example puppets.

capabilities.capability: One-click line-art set-ups that create a drawing object tracing the whole scene, a collection or one object.
capabilities.pro_use: Fast toon outlines for 3D layouts and animatics.

match.note: No 3D-to-ink line generation; Blender in-process for 3D sets and Grease Pencil 3 is WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Per-object (and per-layer) switch for whether strokes react to scene lights.
capabilities.pro_use: Keep flat colour for cel style, or let lights shade drawings placed in a lit 3D set.

match.note: style.toon gives cel shadows and rims from a fixed light in the SVG renderer; the grease-pencil renderer turns GP lights off. Toon shading in other renderers is WP-14.

capabilities.capability: Drawing data can be linked so several objects share one drawing.
capabilities.pro_use: Instancing the same character or prop many times; one fix updates them all.

match.note: Cast entries reference one puppet file; any number of shots and cast members reuse it.

capabilities.capability: Stroke depth order chosen between the 2D layer list and real 3D position.
capabilities.pro_use: 2D order for flat cut-out work; 3D order when drawings live inside a 3D scene.

match.note: 2D draw order only, but it can be animated by controls and clips; no 3D depth ordering.

capabilities.capability: Custom attributes on layers and custom properties on the drawing data.
capabilities.pro_use: Pipelines tag layers and drawings with data their scripts read (status, pass names, variants).

match.note: Parts carry free attributes (attrs: any JSON), kept by every tool and ignored by the renderers.

capabilities.capability: Vertex groups: named, weighted sets of points used by deformers and filters.
capabilities.pro_use: Bind parts of a drawing to bones or limit an effect to an area.

match.note: Mesh strokes (v0.5) store per-vertex part weights; ordinary strokes follow their single part.

capabilities.capability: Per-curve render settings: fill opacity, start and end caps, edge softness, texture scale and aspect.
capabilities.pro_use: Fine-tuning line ends and soft fills for a painterly look.

match.note: Stroke opacity exists; caps are fixed round and softness/texture scale are missing (medium simulation, WP-15).

capabilities.capability: A layer tree with layer groups; each stroke belongs to one layer and new strokes go to the active one.
capabilities.pro_use: Separate line, colour, shadow and effects layers, grouped per character.

match.note: Puppet parts act as layers in a bone hierarchy; scene-level layers are the set, underlays, cast and overlays. No free layer groups.

capabilities.capability: Per-layer visibility, locking, hide-others and auto-lock of inactive layers.
capabilities.pro_use: Protects finished work while drawing on one layer.

match.note: Viewport editing conveniences; agents edit JSON through commands. Locks on films and characters for people are WP-39.

capabilities.capability: Any layer can mask others (above or below), with invert and several masks per layer.
capabilities.pro_use: Clip drawings inside shapes (eyes inside sockets, a character inside a window).

match.note: Masks and mattes are WP-36 (node compositor). SVG clip paths are used internally (toon, mesh triangles) but not exposed as a mask field.

capabilities.capability: Per-layer blend modes and opacity.
capabilities.pro_use: Multiply shadow layers, add glows, fade layers in and out.

match.note: Stroke opacity exists; blend modes and keyed layer opacity are WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Per-layer location, rotation and scale.
capabilities.pro_use: Nudge or animate parts of a drawing without redrawing.

match.note: Parts rotate about pivots, move with pose shifts and scale per part (v0.9), with layer order keys; every renderer draws them.

capabilities.capability: Layer adjustments: tint all colours on a layer by a factor and override stroke thickness.
capabilities.pro_use: Push a character into night or silhouette quickly; unify line weight.

match.note: Palette slots allow runtime recolour; palette variants per scene are WP-16. A layer-wide line-weight override is missing (WP-15).

capabilities.capability: A layer can be parented to an object or bone and inherit its motion.
capabilities.pro_use: The basis of cut-out rigs: each body part on its own layer riding a bone.

match.note: This is the puppet skeleton itself.

capabilities.capability: Layer pass index for restricting modifiers and effects to some layers.
capabilities.pro_use: Apply a noise or tint only to the effects layers.

match.note: Doodleberry targets parts by id; it has no per-layer modifier stack to filter (see gp-modifier-stack-3).

capabilities.capability: Assign layers to render view layers to split a drawing into passes for compositing.
capabilities.pro_use: Render characters, lines and shadows separately and combine them in comp.

match.note: Characters are already rendered with alpha and composited over the set video; arbitrary passes (OpenEXR multi-pass) are WP-37.

capabilities.capability: Duplicate a layer with empty keyframes, and merge layers down, by group or all.
capabilities.pro_use: Set up clean-up and colour layers that follow the rough animation's timing.

match.note: Drawn levels, clean-up of rough lines and colour styles across frames are WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Ghosts of earlier and later frames or keyframes around the current frame, with counts before and after.
capabilities.pro_use: Core of frame-by-frame animation: spacing and arcs are judged against neighbouring drawings.

match.note: The Rig Canvas 'Onion' shows the rest of the character faintly in space, not neighbouring frames in time.

capabilities.capability: Onion skin switched per layer, and per material whether it appears in ghosts.
capabilities.pro_use: Ghost only the layer being animated so the view stays readable.

match.note: Part of onion skins in WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Custom colours for past and future ghosts, overall opacity and fading with distance.
capabilities.pro_use: Tell direction of motion at a glance.

match.note: Part of onion skins in WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Ghost only keyframes picked by hand in the timeline.
capabilities.pro_use: Compare against chosen key poses, not every in-between.

match.note: Part of onion skins in WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Show the first frame as a ghost when on the last frame of a loop; limit ghosts to the active object.
capabilities.pro_use: Seamless cycles (walks, idles, smoke loops).

match.note: Clip loops exist for rigged motion (clip loop flag), but there is no visual loop check for drawings.

capabilities.capability: Non-destructive stack of procedural operations on strokes, evaluated in order and editable at any time.
capabilities.pro_use: Artists keep drawings clean and add wobble, thickness and colour changes as reversible steps.

match.note: Shot style options (boil, toon, step, shadow) and post presets act non-destructively, but in a fixed order; a general ordered effects graph is WP-36 (with the graph view of WP-20).

capabilities.capability: Apply a modifier to the current keyframe or to all keyframes, turning the result into real strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Freeze procedural results so they can be hand-tweaked.

match.note: The bake (tools/bake.mjs) and the grease-pencil exporter write deformed per-frame strokes, but not back into editable drawings; editable drawn frames are WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Influence filters: limit a modifier by layer or group, layer pass, material, material pass, vertex group, or a falloff curve along the stroke.
capabilities.pro_use: Wobble only the hair, thin only the outline, taper only stroke ends.

match.note: Looks apply per shot (boil has per-layer seeds); per-part or per-palette-slot targeting of line styles fits WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Custom modifiers built as Geometry Nodes groups.
capabilities.pro_use: Technical artists write studio-specific stroke effects.

match.note: A Geometry Nodes set is built and rendered by Blender (proc.cook gn_set); user-written node groups are WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Array: repeat strokes with offsets, object-driven spacing and random variation.
capabilities.pro_use: Fences, crowds of simple shapes, repeated motion-graphic elements.

match.note: Seeded scatter and instancing (crowds, Geometry Nodes blocks) exist; arrays of strokes with offsets are WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Build: strokes appear or vanish over time as if drawn or erased, one by one or together, optionally at the recorded drawing speed, with fades.
capabilities.pro_use: Write-on titles, drawings that draw themselves, explainer reveals.

match.note: Kit 'draw' elements draw themselves with a pen-scratch sound; puppet strokes cannot be written on. Extending draw-on to character and prop lines fits WP-15 (kinetic and stroke effects).

capabilities.capability: Dot Dash: break strokes into dash-and-gap patterns, each segment with its own material and thickness.
capabilities.pro_use: Dashed guide lines, stitches, motion trails, map routes.

match.note: Whisper bubbles are dashed and some generated cast details use fixed dashes; no dash field on puppet strokes (WP-15).

capabilities.capability: Envelope: generate extra strokes around existing ones for a sketchy or hairy look.
capabilities.pro_use: Rough pencil looks and stylised fur from simple lines.

match.note: Medium simulation for vector lines is WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Length: extend or shorten strokes, following curvature, with randomness.
capabilities.pro_use: Overshooting construction lines, animated line growth.

match.note: No stroke-length operations.

capabilities.capability: Mirror: mirror strokes across axes.
capabilities.pro_use: Draw half of a symmetric object and get the other half.

match.note: Whole characters flip (place.flip) and mirrored clips exist; puppet.coach measures left/right mismatch. Symmetric drawing in the Rig Canvas is WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Multiple Strokes: duplicate strokes with offsets and fading for a multi-pass sketch look.
capabilities.pro_use: Hand-sketched, re-traced line quality.

match.note: Medium simulation for vector lines is WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Outline: turn strokes into outlines around their shape with a chosen material, as seen from the camera.
capabilities.pro_use: Consistent ink outlines around fills, sticker-style borders.

match.note: Every filled shape can carry an ink outline; toon shading uses outline offsets. Title kit elements have an outline option.

capabilities.capability: Simplify: reduce point counts by fixed steps, adaptive tolerance, resampling or merging close points.
capabilities.pro_use: Lighter files and cleaner curves after rough drawing.

match.note: The Rig Canvas simplifies strokes while drawing (Ramer-Douglas-Peucker) and imports flatten paths; no simplify operation on existing strokes.

capabilities.capability: Subdivide: add points to smooth strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Smoother deformation of strokes that bend with bones.

match.note: SVG paths are resolution-independent curves; mesh strokes are subdivided at import when needed.

capabilities.capability: Armature: bones deform stroke points by vertex groups or bone envelopes.
capabilities.pro_use: Cut-out and bendy character rigs inside Blender.

match.note: Rigid parts on bones, bendy limbs and skinned mesh strokes; every renderer reads the baked result.

capabilities.capability: Hook: points follow a controller object with falloff.
capabilities.pro_use: Pull a cheek or tail tip with a handle.

match.note: Pose shifts and driven controls move whole parts and swaps; point-level hooks and further constraints are WP-11.

capabilities.capability: Lattice: deform strokes through a cage.
capabilities.pro_use: Squash, stretch and warp whole drawings smoothly.

match.note: Whole-body squash, bendy limbs and per-part squash and stretch exist; free-form cage warps are WP-18 (Rig Canvas tools).

capabilities.capability: Noise: seeded jitter of position, thickness, opacity and texture, changing every N frames or on keyframes.
capabilities.pro_use: Hand-made line boil on clean digital lines.

match.note: style.boil {fps, amount, freq} gives deterministic, stepped displacement on characters, bubbles and signs; thickness and opacity noise are not included.

capabilities.capability: Offset: shift, rotate and scale strokes per layer, material or stroke, with randomisation.
capabilities.pro_use: Break the uniformity of repeated drawings; animate parts offset from each other.

match.note: Crowds vary each copy (puppet, facing, idle phase and speed, gaze, reaction timing) from a seed; per-stroke random offsets are WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Shrinkwrap: project strokes onto 3D surfaces.
capabilities.pro_use: Draw markings that stick to a 3D model.

match.note: Doodleberry characters are 2D; 3D sets with Grease Pencil 3 are in WP-42 if this becomes useful.

capabilities.capability: Smooth: smooth position, thickness, opacity or texture along strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Remove jitter from tablet input or from deformations.

match.note: Rig Canvas ink is smoothed while drawing; no smoothing of existing strokes.

capabilities.capability: Thickness: set or scale line width, normalise it, or shape it along the stroke with a curve.
capabilities.pro_use: Consistent line weight across a production; tapered ends.

match.note: Each stroke has a width and ink import keeps line weight under squash; no global or along-stroke width control.

capabilities.capability: Hue, saturation and value shift on strokes and fills.
capabilities.pro_use: Colour variants and mood shifts without repainting.

match.note: shots.json post grades shift the whole picture and set_opts recolour sets; per-character palette variants are WP-16.

capabilities.capability: Opacity: change stroke and fill opacity, set hardness, or make it uniform.
capabilities.pro_use: Fade characters or effects; soft-edged lines.

match.note: Stroke opacity is static data; keyed opacity of parts or characters and soft edges are WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Tint: blend a colour over strokes and fills, solid or as a gradient by distance to an object.
capabilities.pro_use: Atmospheric depth, a light source tinting nearby drawings.

match.note: Palette slots support recolouring; palette variants per scene are WP-16; distance-based gradient tint is not planned.

capabilities.capability: Texture Mapping: move, rotate and scale the texture along strokes or across fills.
capabilities.pro_use: Brush-texture lines and animated patterns.

match.note: Textured line styles (pencil, marker, crayon) are WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Time Offset: shift drawing keys in time, reverse them, show a fixed frame, ping-pong or chain modes, loop and speed.
capabilities.pro_use: Reuse cycles (walks, smoke, rain), desynchronise copies, pick mouth drawings by frame.

match.note: Rigged motion already has clip start, speed and loop, and swaps pick drawings by name; time remapping of drawn frames is WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Vertex Weight Angle: weights from stroke direction.
capabilities.pro_use: Calligraphic thick-thin lines that depend on angle.

match.note: A pen-nib look belongs with the vector line styles of WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Vertex Weight Proximity: weights from distance to an object.
capabilities.pro_use: Fade or thin lines with depth or near a light.

match.note: Depth-driven effects fit the multiplane depth of WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Generate ink strokes from 3D meshes as seen by the camera, with occlusion.
capabilities.pro_use: Toon outlines on 3D sets and props so they match 2D characters.

match.note: 3D sets get ink lines from their meshes as the camera sees them, with occlusion (Freestyle in the gn_set render); writing them as editable strokes is WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Choose edge types: contour and silhouette, creases by angle, intersections, material borders, marked edges, light contours and cast-shadow edges.
capabilities.pro_use: Control which lines read as drawn ink.

match.note: Part of 3D line art in WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Illumination filtering (lit or shaded regions) and filled shapes from enclosed regions.
capabilities.pro_use: Shadow shapes and two-tone fills generated from 3D lighting.

match.note: Part of 3D line art in WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Occlusion levels, line chaining and smoothing, and a shared cache across several line-art modifiers.
capabilities.pro_use: Hidden-line views and performance on dense scenes.

match.note: Part of 3D line art in WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Write results to a chosen layer and material with set radius and opacity, then bake to editable strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Hand-touch generated lines for final shots.

match.note: Part of 3D line art in WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Blur (also usable as depth-of-field style blur) over the whole object.
capabilities.pro_use: Soften background drawings, fake focus.

match.note: Blurs and depth of field are WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Colorize: greyscale, sepia, duotone, transparency or a custom colour.
capabilities.pro_use: Flashbacks, silhouettes and stylised looks.

match.note: Picture-wide post presets (noir, warm, cool) and ffmpeg grades exist; per-object colour effects are WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Flip horizontally or vertically.
capabilities.pro_use: Mirror a character to face the other way.

match.note: Placement flip mirrors a whole character.

capabilities.capability: Glow: bloom around colours above a threshold.
capabilities.pro_use: Magic, screens, lamps and neon.

match.note: Glows are WP-36; note that WP-04's lint flags neon glow as a generic-AI look.

capabilities.capability: Pixelate.
capabilities.pro_use: Retro looks, censoring, transitions.

match.note: An image-space node in the compositor (WP-36).

capabilities.capability: Rim: offset coloured rim around the drawing with a blend mode.
capabilities.pro_use: Back-light accents that separate characters from the background.

match.note: style.toon rim lighting works in the SVG renderer only; other renderers are WP-14.

capabilities.capability: Shadow: offset drop shadow with blur and optional wave.
capabilities.pro_use: Lift characters off flat backgrounds.

match.note: Ground shadows (style.shadow) and cel shadows exist; offset drop shadows are WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Swirl distortion.
capabilities.pro_use: Dizziness, hypnosis and transition gags.

match.note: Distortion nodes belong to WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Wave distortion.
capabilities.pro_use: Heat haze, underwater wobble, dream sequences.

match.note: style.boil is a turbulent displacement for line shimmer; directed wave distortion is WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Each material has independent stroke and fill parts that can be switched on or off.
capabilities.pro_use: Line-only, fill-only or line-and-fill shapes from one set of materials.

match.note: Either can be 'none'.

capabilities.capability: Shared material slots: changing a material updates every stroke that uses it.
capabilities.pro_use: Global colour changes and colour-model consistency across a production.

match.note: Palette slots name every colour; puppet.lint flags raw colours; cast.generate sets skin, hair and outfit colours.

capabilities.capability: Line styles of dots or squares with spacing by count, radius or density, alignment, rotation and random size, strength, rotation and colour.
capabilities.pro_use: Stippled, chalky or particle-like lines and dotted trails.

match.note: Medium simulation for vector lines is WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Image textures mapped along strokes and over fills, mixed with the base colour.
capabilities.pro_use: Paper, pencil grain and fabric patterns on drawings.

match.note: Raster parts and skinned mesh strokes carry painted texture (SVG renderer only, WP-14); textured vector lines and fills are WP-15. Paper grain exists as a picture-wide post pass.

capabilities.capability: Gradient fills, linear or radial, with a second colour and an in-viewport tool to place the gradient.
capabilities.pro_use: Soft shading, skies and glowing objects.

match.note: Puppet strokes are flat fills; puppet.import flattens SVG gradients. A gradient fill style would join WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Holdout: a stroke or fill erases what lies beneath it.
capabilities.pro_use: Cut holes and reveal effects without masks.

match.note: Masks and mattes are WP-36.

capabilities.capability: Self-overlap control for semi-transparent strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Even transparency where a translucent stroke crosses itself.

match.note: An SVG path with opacity never darkens where it crosses itself.

capabilities.capability: Material visibility, locking, isolation and ghost visibility in the slot list.
capabilities.pro_use: Protect colour work while editing lines.

match.note: Viewport editing conveniences.

capabilities.capability: Draw, edit, sculpt or paint weights on many selected keyframes at once.
capabilities.pro_use: Fix a prop or line across a whole drawn sequence in one pass.

match.note: For rigged characters one edit to a part already changes every frame; for drawn levels this is WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Falloff curve so the change fades with distance from the current frame.
capabilities.pro_use: Gradual corrections across a range of drawings.

match.note: Part of drawn levels (WP-35).

capabilities.capability: Fill and stroke-pairing work across several frames.
capabilities.pro_use: Colour a whole drawn sequence quickly.

match.note: Colour styles applied across every frame are WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Animate the drawing object as a whole: position, rotation and size over time.
capabilities.pro_use: Slide-ons, camera-relative moves, simple motion graphics.

match.note: Placement, travel with foot pins and camera keys, folded into the bake for every renderer.

capabilities.capability: Frame-by-frame drawing: keyframes that each hold a complete drawing.
capabilities.pro_use: Traditional hand-drawn animation and effects (splashes, smoke).

match.note: Drawn levels with exposures are WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Inherited animation from parents, hooks and armatures (cut-out).
capabilities.pro_use: Rig-driven acting with reusable motion.

match.note: Rigged clips, poses, IK and controls, placed by hand, from prose or from the voice.

capabilities.capability: Auto-key and additive drawing: a new key starts from the previous drawing.
capabilities.pro_use: Fast straight-ahead animation that changes only what moves.

match.note: Part of drawn levels and the X-sheet in WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Interpolate tool: drag to create a breakdown drawing between two keys at a chosen blend.
capabilities.pro_use: Quick in-betweens for simple shapes.

match.note: In-between assistance for drawn levels is WP-35, with ML proposals in WP-43.

capabilities.capability: Interpolate sequence: fill every frame between two keys, with step, easing type, layer scope, smoothing and stroke flip handling.
capabilities.pro_use: Generate spacing for tweened shape changes on twos or with easing.

match.note: Rig poses and clips already interpolate with easing and stepped timing; interpolating between two drawings is WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Insert blank, duplicate or delete keyframes on the active or all layers, with a duration.
capabilities.pro_use: Block timing and holds in drawn animation.

match.note: Exposure sheet (X-sheet) is WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Bake object transform animation into drawing keyframes over a frame range with a step.
capabilities.pro_use: Turn moves into editable per-frame drawings or hand to another tool.

match.note: The grease-pencil renderer bakes acting and camera into world-space strokes and writes one GP keyframe per frame.

capabilities.capability: Animating on twos or threes by stepped keys and interpolation steps.
capabilities.pro_use: A hand-made cadence for cartoon timing.

match.note: style.step animates a shot on 12s, 8s or 6s while the film stays at 30 fps.

capabilities.capability: Key types (keyframe, breakdown and others) shown and filtered separately.
capabilities.pro_use: Separate key poses from in-betweens during blocking and polish.

match.note: Belongs with the X-sheet of WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Freehand brush with pressure, active smoothing, spacing and screen-space simplify.
capabilities.pro_use: The everyday drawing tool for roughs and final lines.

match.note: Rig Canvas ink uses pressure (or speed-simulated pressure) with smoothing and simplify; a stabiliser is WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Brush assets: preset and custom pencils, inks, markers, fills and erasers kept in shared libraries.
capabilities.pro_use: Studio-wide brush sets keep every artist's lines consistent.

match.note: Brush engines (libmypaint, Krita) are evaluated in WP-34; textured brushes in WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Fill tool: detects closed regions from geometry or pixels, closes gaps by radius or extension, supports fill guides, inverted fill and layer scope.
capabilities.pro_use: Fast flat colouring of line art, including slightly open lines.

match.note: The Rig Canvas bucket closes gaps up to about 10 px, tucks the fill under the ink and refuses open outlines; fill guides, solver choice and layer scope are missing (WP-18).

capabilities.capability: Erasers: soft, hard, point and whole-stroke, cutting strokes at intersections; box and lasso erase.
capabilities.pro_use: Clean up and shape lines while drawing.

match.note: The Rig Canvas has undo and clear-slot only; an eraser is in WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Trim tool: cut stroke ends back to where they cross other strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Tidy overshooting lines after rough inking.

match.note: Drawing tools in WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Shape tools: line, polyline, arc, curve, box and circle.
capabilities.pro_use: Props, backgrounds and graphic elements with precise shapes.

match.note: Agents can write any SVG path directly and kit elements draw shapes in code; the Rig Canvas has freehand and fill shapes only.

capabilities.capability: Eyedropper to pick colours or materials from the screen.
capabilities.pro_use: Match colours from reference.

match.note: Colours are palette slots chosen by name.

capabilities.capability: Drawing planes and stroke placement: draw at the origin, the cursor, on surfaces or on other strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Draw in 3D space around models and sets.

match.note: Drawing is on a 2D artboard; 3D drawing would come with WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Drawing options: auto-merge onto stroke ends, draw behind existing strokes, add bone weights to new strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Paint colour under ink on one layer and keep new drawing bound to the rig.

match.note: Fills are tucked under ink and every stroke drawn into a part follows that part's bone; auto-merge is missing.

capabilities.capability: Select points and strokes by click, box, circle or lasso.
capabilities.pro_use: Pick exactly the lines to adjust.

match.note: Parts and swap shapes are addressed by id; cut polygons and pivots are confirmed in /doodle. Polygon editing is WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Transform points: move, rotate, scale, bend, shear, push to a sphere, change radius.
capabilities.pro_use: Correct proportions and fix drawings without redrawing.

match.note: Pivots and cut polygons can be moved; general point editing is WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Pen tool for Bezier strokes and handle and corner types.
capabilities.pro_use: Precise vector shapes for props and clean-up.

match.note: Bezier paths come in through layered SVG (e.g. from Inkscape); no Bezier editing tool.

capabilities.capability: Stroke operations: subdivide, smooth, simplify, join, split, close, set caps, flip direction, set start point.
capabilities.pro_use: Day-to-day clean-up of vector lines.

match.note: Vector stroke editing belongs with the Rig Canvas upgrade (WP-18).

capabilities.capability: Convert stroke curve types with a fitting threshold.
capabilities.pro_use: Turn rough polylines into editable smooth curves.

match.note: With vector tracing in WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Outline operator: turn a line into a filled outline shape.
capabilities.pro_use: Make variable-width ink editable as a shape.

match.note: Rig Canvas ink is already stored as filled outline shapes; converting existing lines is not available.

capabilities.capability: Move strokes to another layer, assign a material, and arrange draw order.
capabilities.pro_use: Reorganise drawings and recolour them.

match.note: Edited in the puppet JSON (written back through puppet.save).

capabilities.capability: Clean up: remove loose points, duplicate frames and near-duplicate points, reproject strokes, remove fill guides.
capabilities.pro_use: Lighter, tidier files before final render.

match.note: Ink import removes specks and renders link duplicate frames by hash; clean-up of drawn frames is WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Separate, duplicate, copy and paste strokes between layers and objects.
capabilities.pro_use: Reuse drawings and split one drawing into rig parts.

match.note: doodle.cut and puppet.from_ink cut one drawing into parts; puppet.export_layers/puppet.import round-trip parts; free copy and paste is WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Brushes to smooth lines and raise or lower their thickness and opacity locally.
capabilities.pro_use: Refine line quality after inking.

match.note: No sculpt brushes on existing strokes.

capabilities.capability: Brushes to grab, push, twist, pinch and inflate strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Reshape drawings quickly between poses.

match.note: No reshaping brushes.

capabilities.capability: Randomize brush: add local jitter to points.
capabilities.pro_use: Hand-made imperfection in chosen areas.

match.note: style.boil jitters whole shots deterministically; brushed local jitter is missing.

capabilities.capability: Clone brush: stamp copied strokes under the brush.
capabilities.pro_use: Scatter leaves, grass or repeated marks.

match.note: Scatter and instancing are WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Selection masks and auto-masking by stroke, layer or material.
capabilities.pro_use: Sculpt only the intended lines.

match.note: Follows the sculpt brushes.

capabilities.capability: Multiframe sculpting across keys.
capabilities.pro_use: Fix shapes over a whole drawn sequence.

match.note: Needs drawn levels (WP-35).

capabilities.capability: Paint colour onto points, mixed over the material colour, on strokes, fills or both.
capabilities.pro_use: Shading and colour variation without new materials.

match.note: Colour is per stroke from palette slots; per-point colour belongs with medium simulation (WP-15).

capabilities.capability: Tint tool in draw mode to recolour strokes with a brush.
capabilities.pro_use: Quick colour corrections on finished drawings.

match.note: Palette slots can be recoloured in the Rig Canvas; brushed per-stroke recolour is missing.

capabilities.capability: Blur, average, smear and replace colour brushes.
capabilities.pro_use: Blend painted colour smoothly.

match.note: With per-point colour in WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Colour adjustments on painted colours: levels, hue/saturation/value, brightness/contrast, invert, reset.
capabilities.pro_use: Grade a character's colours to match a scene.

match.note: Palette edits and picture-wide grades exist; palette variants per scene are WP-16.

capabilities.capability: Paint bone influence weights on points for cut-out deformation.
capabilities.pro_use: Smooth bends at joints in rigged drawings.

match.note: Skinned mesh strokes with per-vertex weights come from Blender cut-out rigs via puppet.from_blend; bendy limbs need no weights. No weight-painting tool (WP-18).

capabilities.capability: Blur, average and smear weight brushes.
capabilities.pro_use: Even out deformation.

match.note: Follows weight painting.

capabilities.capability: Weight heat-map display while painting.
capabilities.pro_use: See which bone moves which line.

match.note: puppet.coach annotates joint gaps under bending, not weights.

capabilities.capability: New strokes and painting automatically add to the active vertex group.
capabilities.pro_use: Keep new drawings bound to the rig.

match.note: Strokes drawn into a part follow that part's bone automatically; group weights are not painted.

capabilities.capability: Weights drive other effects (thickness, opacity, influence filters).
capabilities.pro_use: Taper or fade lines by painted weight.

match.note: Per-point attributes and line styles are WP-15.

capabilities.capability: Trace a black-and-white image into strokes with a threshold, stroke radius and turn policy.
capabilities.pro_use: Bring paper drawings and logos in as editable lines.

match.note: Scans and photos become raster-part puppets in the artist's own line and doodles get cut and rigged; vector tracing (VTracer, potrace) is WP-18.

capabilities.capability: Trace an image sequence into one drawing per frame.
capabilities.pro_use: Convert paper animation tests into drawn keys.

match.note: Drawn levels from scanned sequences are WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Convert meshes and curves into drawing strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Use 3D or curve shapes as a starting point for 2D drawings.

match.note: 3D and Blender in-process work is WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Bind drawings to an armature so bones deform stroke points (vertex groups or envelopes).
capabilities.pro_use: Cut-out characters animated by posing bones.

match.note: puppet.from_blend also imports Blender cut-out rigs (bones, sprite and shape-key variants) into puppets.

capabilities.capability: Automatic weights from bone envelopes, without painting.
capabilities.pro_use: Fast rigging of simple shapes.

match.note: Bendy limbs curve smoothly out of their parent with no weights; puppet.import estimates pivots from the drawing.

capabilities.capability: Blender's IK, constraints and drivers applied to bones that move drawings.
capabilities.pro_use: Planted feet, reaching hands, controls that drive several parts.

match.note: Two-bone IK, FABRIK chains, joint limits, look-at and driven controls; IK/FK blending, copy rotation and follow path are WP-11.

capabilities.capability: Reusable actions and poses applied to rigs.
capabilities.pro_use: Library of cycles and gestures shared across shots.

match.note: Template-level clip library and per-character clips; actout.clip turns a filmed take into a clip.

capabilities.capability: Objects parented to bones and hooks so props follow hands.
capabilities.pro_use: Props passed between characters in cut-out scenes.

match.note: Props attach to a character's part and switch parents with arcs (SVG player only; other renderers refuse props, WP-14).

capabilities.capability: Each layer is a channel of drawing keys that can be moved, scaled and retimed.
capabilities.pro_use: Block a shot's timing and adjust holds.

match.note: The Studio timeline moves and resizes clip layers per character, line-relative; channels of drawn keys are WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Copy and paste keys between layers and objects, including paste by layer.
capabilities.pro_use: Reuse timing and drawings across characters.

match.note: With the X-sheet in WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Breakdown keys shown distinctly, with an operator to delete them.
capabilities.pro_use: Strip generated in-betweens and re-time.

match.note: With in-between assistance in WP-35.

capabilities.capability: Layer opacity, mask, onion, visibility and lock toggles, solo and isolate in the channel list.
capabilities.pro_use: Manage layers while timing.

match.note: Editor conveniences.

capabilities.capability: Strokes rendered in EEVEE with SMAA thresholds and SSAA sample count for anti-aliasing.
capabilities.pro_use: Clean, smooth lines in final renders.

match.note: renderer 'grease-pencil' renders with EEVEE at half resolution and upscales; DBE_GP_SAMPLES sets the samples.

capabilities.capability: Motion blur steps for strokes.
capabilities.pro_use: Natural blur on fast moves.

match.note: Sub-frame motion blur on fast shots is WP-15.

capabilities.capability: A dedicated Grease Pencil render pass and per-view-layer inclusion.
capabilities.pro_use: Comp drawings separately from 3D.

match.note: Characters render with alpha over the set, and film.master writes beauty, line, fill and matte passes.

capabilities.capability: Transparent background rendering for compositing.
capabilities.pro_use: Lay drawn characters over painted or live backgrounds.

match.note: The grease-pencil path renders RGBA frames composited over the SVG set by ffmpeg.

capabilities.capability: Output resolution, frame rate and colour view transform.
capabilities.pro_use: Deliver to spec.

match.note: qa.run checks 1080x1920 and 30 fps; the renderer uses the Standard view transform. Colour management (OCIO, ACES) is WP-37.

capabilities.capability: Save the drawing as a native, editable project for further work in the tool.
capabilities.pro_use: Hand a shot to a Blender artist for hand-finishing.

match.note: shot.render writes build/shots/<id>.gp.json and frames, not a .blend; the feature map lists Grease Pencil project export as done, which WP-01 should correct. Saving the .blend fits WP-14 (renderer parity).

capabilities.capability: Import SVG as strokes with resolution, scale and centring options.
capabilities.pro_use: Bring vector art from Inkscape or Illustrator into animation.

match.note: Layered SVG becomes a puppet, with parts, swaps and pivots taken from layer names.

capabilities.capability: Export SVG for one frame, selected keys or the whole range as animation, with fill, uniform width and camera clipping options.
capabilities.pro_use: Vector stills and animations for the web and print.

match.note: Layered SVG of a puppet in rest pose, Lottie and a live web player exist; animated SVG and other formats are WP-23.

capabilities.capability: Export PDF with one page per frame.
capabilities.pro_use: Flipbooks, print checks and review packets.

match.note: film.storyboard writes a contact PDF (six shots a page); per-frame print books fit WP-30 (comics and storybooks from shot data).

capabilities.capability: Read and write layers, strokes and attributes of drawings in node trees.
capabilities.pro_use: Procedural generation and editing of 2D drawings.

match.note: Procedural 2D as data and Blender in-process are WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Nodes to set stroke colour, depth and softness, merge layers, and convert between drawings and curves.
capabilities.pro_use: Build custom procedural looks and pipelines.

match.note: Part of WP-42.

capabilities.capability: Node Tools: node groups exposed as custom operators in drawing and edit modes.
capabilities.pro_use: Studio-specific one-click tools for artists.

match.note: Doodleberry's own tools are @command functions listed by engine.commands (CLI, HTTP, Studio, MCP); procedural tools on strokes are WP-42.
